page_title: Nano Banana - AI 图像生成平台

sources.entry: Nano Banana (nanobananana.com) - Independent third-party image creation tool for text-to-image generation, natural-language reference image editing, and multi-image blending, with a Chinese interface. #freemium

summary.name: Nano Banana
summary.one_liner: Nano Banana is a third-party AI image generation platform built on Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash Image model, offering text-to-image generation and natural-language image editing with a Chinese-language interface.
use_cases: Editing a photo with plain-language instructions
Blending up to nine reference images into one composite
Keeping a character consistent across style changes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web tool for generating AI images from text prompts or transforming existing images. Users can upload up to 9 reference images in image-to-image mode, then describe the desired result in natural language. The platform claims identity-consistent editing, multi-image blending, and precise local edits that leave surrounding areas unchanged. Generated images include Google's SynthID watermark. The page lists three paid monthly plans (Starter, Plus, Ultra) that differ in credits, history length, and license type.
notable: Built on Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, described as an unofficial community nickname for the model
Generated images carry Google SynthID watermarks
Supports up to 9 reference images in image-to-image mode
caveats: Paid plans required for watermark-free output and commercial license: Starter (100 credits/month), Plus (500), Ultra (1,600)
Free tier details not stated on the page
Independent third-party site, not an official Google product
